member.name: T:MOM.CC.Quality.Public.Enum.IndustryRule
member.summary:
Builtin types of industry specific rules. ----------------------------------------- - EXPERT: The expert or so-called custom rule is actually not a rule because it only opens the list for defining your own particular rule set.
- QC_ATT: Typically used for X-bar, Individual, and Median charts. It is also used for R charts when the minimum subgroup size is at least 4.
- QC_ATTA: Typically used for p, np, c, and u charts.
- QC_ATTR: Typically used for R charts when the minimum subgroup size is less than 4.
- QC_EXCEEDLIMITS: Typically used only when the user wants to know when points drop outside of the control limits.
- QC_FORD1_R: Typically used for R charts.
- QC_FORD1_X: Typically used for X-Bar charts.
- QC_JCAHO: Typically used to evaluate data utilizing the Joint Commission on Accreditation of Healthcare Organizations (JCAHO) rules.
- QC_FORDX: Similar to QC_FORD1_X but contains considerably more “Out of Control” tests. Typically used for X-Bar charts.

member.name: T:MOM.CC.Quality.Public.Enum.Violation
member.summary:
Requested types of violations to check. --------------------------------------- - Specification: Upper and lower tolerance.
- CL_1: Check the control limits in chart 1.
- WL_1: Check the warning limits in chart 1.
- Run_1: Check for run in chart 1.
- Trend_1: Check for trend in chart 1.
- MiddleThird: Perform the middle-third test.
- CL_2: Check the control limits in chart 2.
- WL_2: Check the warning limits in chart 2.
- Run_2: Check for run in chart 2.
- Trend_2: Check for trend in chart 1.
- ZoneRule01: 2 of 3 successive points lie on the same side of the process mean line above the 2σ limit in zone A or outside.
- ZoneRule02: 4 of 5 successive points lie on the same side of the process mean line above the 1σ limit in zone B or outside.
- ZoneRule03: 15 successive points lie within 1/3 (+/-1σ) of the control limits on both sides of the process mean line in zone C (similar to Middlethird).
- ZoneRule04: 3 successive points lie above the +1σ limit in upper zone B or above.
- ZoneRule05: 7 successive points lie above the process mean line in upper zone C or above (like Run).
- ZoneRule06: 10 successive points lie below the process mean line in lower zone C or below (like Run).
- ZoneRule07: 6 successive points lie below the -1σ limit in lower zone B or below.
- ZoneRule08: 4 successive points lie below the -2σ limit in lower zone A.
- ZoneRule09: 14 successive points lie alternatingly at the top and bottom.
- ZoneRule10: 8 successive points lie > 1σ of the process mean line, on both sides in zone B or outside.
- Zone: Generic Zone for future use.
- Alternate: Alternatingly on both sides of the mean line (similar to ZoneRule09).
- Upper and lower tolerance for at least one value of the sample.

member.name: P:MOM.CC.Quality.Public.Model.RuleControls.RuleControl.ClassicalZoneRuleCalculation
member.summary:
Controls how points are marked in zone rule violations pattern detection.
When true (Default): - Uses classical/traditional zone rule interpretation - Marks ALL points participating in a violation pattern - Example: In an "8 points beyond 1σ" rule, all 8 points are marked as violations, even if some points are only 1.1σ from the mean
When false: - Uses selective marking for violation patterns - Only marks points that individually exceed the zone threshold - Points within normal limits are not marked, even if they complete a violation pattern - Example: In an "8 points beyond 1σ" rule, only points actually beyond 1σ are marked, while points within 1σ remain unmarked, even if they're part of the 8-point sequence
Default Value: true (maintains backward compatibility)
Use Cases: - Set to true for traditional SPC analysis highlighting complete patterns - Set to false for more precise violation marking, focusing on actual zone violations
